findings.evidence: `ls code/TauCeti/Algebra/Coalgebra/Comodule` shows only `MatrixCoefficientTransport.lean`; `rg -n "MatrixCoefficientFunctorial|MatrixCoefficientTransport" code roadmap mathlib` finds the old name nowhere and the new module at `MatrixCoefficientTransport.lean:60`, `:74`, and `:92`.
findings.fix: Keep a compatibility module at the old path that publicly imports `TauCeti.Algebra.Coalgebra.Comodule.MatrixCoefficientTransport`, optionally with a docstring marking it as a renamed/deprecated import.
findings.issue: The PR deletes the public module path `TauCeti.Algebra.Coalgebra.Comodule.MatrixCoefficientFunctorial`, so downstream files importing the old module break even though the declaration names are unchanged.

summary: The declarations remain minimal and appropriately annotated, but the rename removes a public Lean module path without a compatibility shim.
